bug_semantics: The Smadex MCP tool get_smadex_report in src/smadex-reporting/src/index.ts accepts downloadUrl as a plain z.string() and passes it to downloadReport, which does await fetch(url) with no scheme, host, IP-range, port, or redirect restrictions. An MCP client (or prompt-injected tool call) can therefore make the local server process request attacker-chosen destinations such as loopback or private-network URLs and return the response body. Adjacent tools create a Smadex report and poll SMADEX_API_BASE_URL for a vendor downloadUrl, but the download step does not bind the fetch to that vendor URL.
flaw_origin: The unrestricted fetch sink and the get_smadex_report tool that feeds it first appear together in aaff3decbc880724bbbe30810a50aa1ac42359c5 (Add smadex mcp), a one-parent commit that added the entire src/smadex-reporting package (index.ts 320 lines). Immediate parent ab4179e9ad97966db18119c3700f69dc849cd760 has no smadex-reporting path. Later commits on that file only bump package versions and leave downloadReport unchanged. This is a first-write of the vulnerable lines, not a move, refactor, revert, backport, release, or squash.
